name: Jaka Wira
bio: Jaka Wira brings the twenty-four sacks of morning rice. He tells the stalls how much he has before he tells the treasury, because the stallholders pay him on days the court does not buy.
notes: fact: North-coast Java was a major source of the rice Melaka imported (docs/research/commodities.md, Rice; Tomé Pires, Suma Oriental, Cortesão ed.)

gameplay: His cargo is the day-one rice on a Javanese jong; Demak and the vessel type are fictional assignments to the existing ship slot (data/briefings/day_01_turn_of_the_monsoon.json; data/port_day.json)

gameplay: Land the cargo before the market runs short and he offers to reserve part of a later shipment for the town. Miss the tide after promising him a berth and he tells Sura to sell to the stalls himself next time (data/events/ev_rice_market_petition.json; data/events/ev_rice_market_thanks.json; docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §§08–09)
